We all have our favourite footwear brands, some big, some small, that we love and wear. Here at Universal Works, we are no exception. We have been following 'Flower Mountain' for a little while now and think they offer a really exciting and innovative addition to our own footwear roster, and importantly, they share much of the same creative inspirations and a love of the natural world. The 'Flower Mountain' story began thanks to a meeting between designers Keisuke Ota from Tokyo & Yang Chao from Beijing, who united by a love of mountain trekking, music and of course, footwear, decided to pursue creating a functional and captivating new style of footwear. We are really excited to have 'Flower Mountain' here at Universal Works, and we are sure you'll love 'em as much as we do!

Celtic knots are among the most recognisable motifs in Celtic art, formed from a single continuous line with no visible beginning or end. This unbroken form has long symbolised eternity, interconnection and the continuity of life, themes central to early Celtic art and manuscript decoration.
This particular design was originally found on a vintage cotton handkerchief. We’ve adapted it for embroidery, translating a traditional textile motif into a new medium while keeping its symbolism intact.
The jersey has enough weight to hold its shape wash after wash, without losing the softness that makes a T-shirt worth reaching for.
